summary: Add bounded, cached, read-only GitHub plugin reads for clients under GET /v1/client/plugins/github/{owner}/{repo}/(pulls/{number}[/conversation|/checks|/files]|issues/{number}|comments/{comment_id}|runs/{run_id})

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; the reads write nothing to the graph.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. Answers are cached in process memory only (512 entries, 64 MiB, 30 seconds fresh, then ETag revalidation for REST), never on disk.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Seven new client-v0 reads (scope read.projections) answer a GithubRead tagged by status: found (stale when served from the cache after an upstream failure), moved, gone, not_found or unavailable, inside the usual Envelope. Path values are typed and validated; no URL is accepted and no redirect is followed. Existing routes, including the plugin mirror's /v1/plugins/github/repos/..., are unchanged. Generated Rust and Swift clients return the read as raw JSON; the TypeScript client types it.

downtime.detail: No startup work. Each read is bounded to 12 seconds, 4 MiB per GitHub response and 100 of each conversation kind and check. File responses list at most 3,000 files and count encoded JSON bytes, omitting patches or excess files with truncated=true to remain below the advertised client response ceiling, with 128,000 bytes reserved for the wrapper and envelope.

manual.detail: No new credential: the reads use the daemon's existing GitHub authentication (gh, token file, app tokens or the sekrets profile) and are spent as plugin/github in the existing GitHub admission accounting.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions; an older daemon simply lacks the routes.
